headline: EU laments the unilateral nature of Trump's new tariffs and denies being a source of overcapacity
summary: The European Union criticised the unilateral nature of new Trump tariffs and denied being a source of overcapacity. It reminded Washington of an agreement capping US tariffs on European goods at 15%.
why: The EU is a major trading bloc, and the US tariff agreement with it sets trade costs for many European exporters. Tariff disputes affect corporate margins and cross-border supply chains.
original_headline: UE lamenta la unilateralidad de los nuevos aranceles de Trump y niega ser fuente de sobrecapacidad
